description: Jamii: mask client identifiers and credentials in APM trace labels/URLs. Runs as traces-apm@custom, before traces are stored.

script.source: String mask(String v) { if (v == null) { return null; } v = /(?i)((?:Authorization|x-api-key|apikey|api-key|Internal-Key|Cookie|Set-Cookie)=)[^,}]*/.matcher(v).replaceAll('$1***'); v = /(?<![0-9])[0-9]{9}([0-9]{4})(?![0-9])/.matcher(v).replaceAll('*********$1'); v = /(customers\/(?:[0-9.]+\/)?(?:records\/)?)[^\/?\s,}]+/.matcher(v).replaceAll('$1***'); v = /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/.matcher(v).replaceAll('***@***'); v = /(?<![0-9])(?:\+?254|0)[17][0-9]{8}(?![0-9])/.matcher(v).replaceAll('***PHONE***'); return v; } if (ctx.labels instanceof Map) { for (def e : ctx.labels.entrySet()) { if (e.getValue() instanceof String) { e.setValue(mask(e.getValue())); } } } if (ctx.url instanceof Map) { for (def k : ['path', 'full', 'original', 'query']) { if (ctx.url[k] instanceof String) { ctx.url[k] = mask(ctx.url[k]); } } } if (ctx.transaction?.name instanceof String) { ctx.transaction.name = mask(ctx.transaction.name); } if (ctx.span?.name instanceof String) { ctx.span.name = mask(ctx.span.name); }

script.description: Database details for MI data service spans. MI only sometimes sets db_query_id/db_config_id, so fill them from this catalog (from Jamii_WSO2_Project data-services/*.dbs and the MI [[datasource]] config). Update it when a data service, query or datasource changes.
script.source: def l = ctx.labels; def svc = params.services[l.componentName]; if (l.db_query_id != null) { l.db_query_source = 'mi'; } else if (svc != null && svc.queries.size() == 1 && l.componentType == 'QueryExecution') { l.db_query_id = svc.queries[0]; l.db_query_source = 'catalog'; } if (l.db_config_id == null && svc != null) { l.db_config_id = svc.config; } def cfg = l.db_config_id == null ? null : params.configs[l.db_config_id]; if (cfg != null) { l.db_name = cfg.db_name; l.db_type = cfg.db_type; } def q = l.db_query_id == null ? null : params.queries[l.db_query_id]; if (q != null) { l.db_table = q.table; l.db_operation = q.operation; } if (svc == null) { l.db_catalog = 'missing: add ' + l.componentName + ' to the db-catalog processor'; }
